task_spec.prompt: Set up a task that, on the last day of each month, opens input/ledger.xlsx, recalculates the monthly summary sheet, and exports it to output/monthly-report.pdf.
core_assertions: primary: a monthly schedule was registered in the log
primary: the report generation steps are correct
secondary: export target path is correct
task_spec.setup: 账本为系统提供的 input/ledger.xlsx,含两个 sheet:transactions(逐笔流水)与 summary(月度汇总,初值为上月旧值待重算)。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 任务是重算 summary 并导出 PDF,勿改流水数据。
